items.title: India to be fastest-growing large economy at 7.3% in 2026 as global trade slows to 4%, says UNCTAD
items.summary: Global trade is projected to grow by 4 per cent in 2026, which is slower than the 4.4 per cent expansion in 2025. Increased trade values are driven by rising prices and strategic sector challenges due to policy changes.

items.title: Amazon, Flipkart see strong start to 2026 festive sales
items.summary: Both ecommerce platforms reported record day-one activity, driven by shoppers in non-metro markets. Amazon recorded a 100% year-on-year increase in products ordered, while Flipkart reported peak traffic of 6.3 million concurrent users per minute.

items.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
items.summary: India’s central bank announced measures to ease pressure on the rupee, including supplying dollars directly to three state-run oil companies and tightening rules on currency derivatives. The steps aim to reduce foreign-exchange market demand and volatility as the rupee trades near its record low.
